questions.q: What does setting "allOrNone": true on a /composite request do?
options: Nothing — it's ignored by the API
Makes the whole composite request behave transactionally: all sub-requests succeed, or the request is rolled back
Doubles the number of allowed sub-requests
Converts the request into a Bulk API 2.0 job
questions.explain: Without allOrNone, earlier successful sub-requests are not automatically rolled back if a later one fails; setting it to true makes the whole request transactional.

questions.q: What is the key difference between /composite and /composite/batch?
options: There is no difference between them
/composite/batch is newer and replaces /composite entirely
/composite sub-requests can reference each other's results via referenceId; /composite/batch sub-requests are independent and cannot cross-reference
/composite only supports GET requests
questions.explain: /composite supports cross-referencing between steps using referenceId; /composite/batch groups independent calls into one request with no such referencing.

questions.q: Which Composite form is the right fit for bulk-creating a flat list of 50 same-type Contact records in one call, with no cross-referencing needed?
options: /composite/graph
/composite/batch only
The Metadata API
/composite/sobjects (sObject Collections)
questions.explain: sObject Collections (/composite/sobjects) is purpose-built for flat bulk CRUD on a list of same-type records, without the added complexity of cross-referencing or multi-object graphs.

questions.q: What are Composite Graph's verified payload limits, per this lesson?
options: Up to 500 nodes per payload, up to 75 graphs per payload, maximum graph depth of 15
Unlimited nodes, unlimited graphs, no depth limit
Up to 25 nodes per payload, no graph limit
Up to 200 nodes per payload, 10 graphs per payload
questions.explain: These are the verified current limits for Composite Graph: 500 nodes and 75 graphs per payload, with a maximum graph depth of 15.

questions.q: How many sub-requests can a single /composite request contain?
options: Up to 500
Up to 25
Unlimited
Exactly 2
questions.explain: A /composite request runs up to 25 sub-requests serially in a single HTTP call.
